text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...Nothing wrong with my body. I ran just 
according to plan.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (...Debut race, complete.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Onto the next.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The race just ended, so how can she be 
so... unbothered, or rather, totally 
calm...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, we got to see another promising new 
star today! ...Still, that girl's a bit 
unusual. Normally you'd celebrate a debut 
win way more than that."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, a girl from overseas, huh... No 
wonder she has a different vibe from 
everyone else... She feels kinda aloof, or 
maybe—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh, heheh, kufufufu—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahaha!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
There you are... I see you...! I feel 
you!! It's you, isn't it...! The dark 
cloud that dares to stand in my way...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Then next, it will be my turn to reel in 
this chain and appear before you...! Turn, 
wheel of fate! Carry our destiny upon 
thee...!"

Symboli Kris S safely finished her debut 
race. Both mentally and physically, she 
remained astonishingly composed...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Mission accomplished. ...I request your 
evaluation.
choice_data_list:
Without a doubt, that was the best run you 
could have given right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me! Sorry right after the race! 
Symboli Kris S-san, could we have a moment 
for a few questions...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I—...do not mind. Trainer, what 
about—"
choice_data_list:
If Symboli Kris S is okay, then there's no 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Truth be told, word 
on the street had it that you were the 
international student invited by the 
renowned Symboli Rudolf-san—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What I want to ask, point-blank, is: What 
is the purpose of Symboli Kris S-san's 
visit to Japan?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Purpose.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Could it perhaps be something like 
studying Japanese racing culture and 
applying it to the races back in your home 
country?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...No. My purpose— for coming to Japan—is 
'revolution.'"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh...? A revolution...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...To bring Japan's racing world— to 
a level—that can compete globally—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I came to Japan... hoping to be... the 
'catalyst' for that."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will—demonstrate strength—here in 
Japan— and show you... a 'revolution.'"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
T-That's quite... a grand goal, isn't 
it...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I will... fulfill it without fail.

After finishing the interview and 
returning to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Rudolf—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for the sudden visit. I just 
really wanted to tell you this directly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“...Calm, yet daring running, just as you 
showed back home. I made sure to witness 
it with my own eyes.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to continue expecting 
great things from you. ...Do your best, 
Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will continue to 
deliver... 'results.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— That's such a typical answer from 
you.

The day after my Debut Race ended with 
Symboli Rudolf's congratulations.

The interview she gave right after her 
debut race was published as an article 
right away, but it ended up causing a bit 
of an unexpected stir—

text_block_list.name: Article Text
text_block_list.text:
"She's here to change the Japanese racing 
world! An assassin from overseas!? Symboli 
Kris S makes a shocking debut!"

text_block_list.name: Article Text
text_block_list.text:
"—Her goal, surprisingly, was to raise the 
bar for Japan's racing world! Declaring 
that she would prove her own strength to 
do so—"

"...There wasn't a single lie written. But 
the article emphasized her 'revolution' 
far more than anyone could have imagined."

After the article went live, some voices 
online called Symboli Kris S's 
"revolution" "none of her business"—

I felt like I had unnecessarily drawn some 
resentment, which left me feeling rather 
down and uneasy...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: It's time. —Let's begin the meeting.
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry. Is it that time already?
Ah, sorry, is it that time already?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...? —...Did something happen?

...She would find out eventually anyway. 
Thinking so, I gave Symboli Kris S a 
concise summary of the article's contents 
and the reactions to it—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. ...Thank you for sharing.
choice_data_list:
Shall I try to get them to retract the 
article?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――No problem. ――It is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I will simply... do what I must. What 
matters is—the "result."

Seeing her utterly unfazed makes me 
reflect on how I must do the same. Just as 
she said, the only thing that matters is 
"results."
choice_data_list:
Alright! Let's switch gears and have a 
meeting!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah. ――I'm counting on you.

Afterward, we wrapped up a quiet 
reflection meeting on her debut race, and 
moved on to reconfirming our future goals—
choice_data_list:
—Let's focus on conditioning your body 
until next January.

text_block_list.text:
In addition, I suggested putting together 
a reasonable race plan so that Symboli 
Kris S could efficiently gain real race 
experience during this period.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—A plan... like this. Training and 
racing— A strategy... a method... aimed 
at—strengthening—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In Japan—what is the correct term to use? 
...What would be the right way to say it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A warrior's pilgrimage... I see. ...That 
is a good name.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Henceforth, I shall carry out my 
warrior's training.

Having decided on our approach to the 
"warrior's pilgrimage," just as we were 
about to start today's training—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahaha!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—I shall bless you, Kris S! With my own 
hands, I celebrate the genesis of the 
world known as you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Gimlet.

The Umamusume who suddenly appeared is 
Tanino Gimlet. Known for her distinct way 
of speaking, she belongs to the same 
generation as Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“However, you know, don't you? We are both 
runners traversing the same era. Bound by 
an inescapable intersection of fate—”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It begins. Who will intoxicate this world 
more deeply, more intensely? A vivid, 
devastating chronicle of war that will 
eclipse even the battles of the gods!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……The die is cast.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is right! We have passed the point of 
no return! Now, all that remains is to 
follow the cries of our inner souls, defy 
time itself, and forge ahead...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Whether that ice-cold running of yours can 
stand before my destructive running that 
scorches all——

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward... to the moment that 
answer is revealed."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I shall do what must be done. —I will 
fulfill my mission.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...That is all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's just fine by you. That's 
PRECISELY what makes it good...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Farewell, steadfast warrior clad in pitch 
black! Go on, sharpen your fangs as best 
you can—

Tanino Gimlet appeared out of nowhere, 
left behind a flurry of cryptic words, and 
vanished, leaving me completely lost in 
the dust—
choice_data_list: ...Tanino Gimlet, what did, um, she say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps it was... encouragement— Gimlet's 
own way of cheering me on—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I do not... understand everything, either. 
But—there are parts I do grasp.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"So I answered. ...My 'stance.' In my own 
words—"

Symboli Kris S and Tanino Gimlet. Though 
they seem like completely different types 
of Umamusume, they appear to share an 
intuitive understanding...
choice_data_list:
...She might turn out to be a formidable 
rival.

...She might turn out to be a formidable 
rival.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. But—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
What I must do—remains unchanged. For now, 
for the sake of my mission... I must 
undergo warrior training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Let's begin, Trainer.

Sensing formidable rivals awaiting in the 
future— her training journey to build the 
foundation for this challenge was about to 
truly begin!
